hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/hook-main.js" || { d="${BRIDGE_HOME:-$HOME/.claude/channels/bridge}/sessions"; m=; case "${BRIDGE_SESSION:-}" in '') for f in "$d"/tmp-*/active.json; do [ -e "$f" ] && m=1; done ;; *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|.|..|__proto__|constructor|prototype) m=1 ;; *) [ -e "$d/$BRIDGE_SESSION/active.json" ] && m=1 ;; esac; [ -z "$m" ] && exit 0; echo 'claude-bridge: the PreToolUse hook could not start (is the plugin built?) while a bridge task is marked active; denying' >&2; exit 2; }
